item.title: 252 health goals you can act on
item.summary: Browse practical, research-backed guides for outcomes like sleeping better, lowering resting heart rate, building strength, and training for an event.
item.details: Every guide works on its own. All seven goal categories are grouped under clear section labels with no more than 12 goals at a time, and every goal now has a simple visual cue that carries into its guide. Search understands common phrasing such as iron man; when there is no exact guide, Start with Murph opens Messages with your goal already filled in.
